test_title: PYST 37 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north. E is to the immediate left of B. C is the immediate neighbour of A and E. Some persons are to the right of F. D is not at any of the end of the row. Who is at the left end of the row?
solution:
Given: 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north.

E is to the immediate left of B.

C is the immediate neighbour of A and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8c4a05a3fa37b6067a8dbb117b17d2249d3d10a2ab2697f04f631dcf8bdfdf2.png] 

Some persons are to the right of F.

D is not at any of the end of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/512aa9be81be8bbc95c9baf7dbb8950344afffd40a80034205f257889929995a.png] 

So, F is at the left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
